metric: share of win-total spread NOT explained by the model's own expectation
method: Var(actual)=..., Var(expected)=..., Var(residual)=... over clubs; expected wins are the walk-forward probabilities summed per club
reading: most of a record is not explained by a rating built only from past margins; that is the ceiling on any 'team strength' claim in this repository, and it is why the leaderboard ranks probabilities, not wins

metric: best strategy's win rate expected from pure noise
n: 12 strategies × 128 games, 4000 simulations, seed frozen in the pre-registration
method: each simulation draws the same number of strategies and games as the real board and records the best hit rate
reading: a strategy only earns attention if its hit rate clears this band; that is why the board is ranked by skill against a base rate with a lower bound, not by who won
